verdict.rationale: Ramp's own materials say it auto-categorizes transactions and syncs coded transactions directly to the ERP, with real-time bidirectional ERP sync. Its integrations directory lists many accounting platforms, including NetSuite, QuickBooks Online and Desktop, Xero, Sage Intacct and Microsoft Dynamics. The evidence is vendor marketing only. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on sync mechanics (field mapping, sync frequency, how expenses and reimbursements sync), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the sync works.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can sync transactions and expenses automatically with my accounting software

citations.quote: Ramp automatically categorizes transactions based on transaction details, historical information, and your team's direct feedback, then syncs coded transactions directly to your ERP.
Real-time bidirectional sync with ERPs eliminates manual journal entries
Accounting: NetSuite, Sage Intacct, QuickBooks Online, QuickBooks Desktop, Xero
GET /developer/v1/banking/syncable-transactions returns banking transactions available to sync to an accounting provider.
